description: This file defines the EmployeesViewDetail class, a view component for the 'detail' page of the 'Employees' module in SuiteCRM. It manages the display of employee details, including module title breadcrumbs, help links, and delete options.

classes.name: EmployeesViewDetail
classes.description: A view class for displaying detailed information about an employee in the SuiteCRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that calls the parent constructor.

methods.name: getModuleTitle
methods.description: Generates the breadcrumb navigation HTML for the module, optionally including help links and create-record links based on user permissions.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Handles the display logic for the employee detail view, including permission-based visibility of edit, delete, and duplicate options.
